pages.title: Megalocnus
pages.text: The Megalocnus ($(o)Megalocnus rodens$()) is an extinct ground sloth that lived on the island of Cuba during the Pleistocene and survived into the Holocene.$(br2)It was the largest of the Caribbean sloths, though far smaller than its giant relatives on the mainland.$(br2)Its name refers to its large, gnawing front teeth, which resembled those of a rodent. Island sloths like Megalocnus outlived the mainland ground sloths by several thousand years.
